summary: Fix race condition in next_id() by adding exclusive file locking using fcntl.flock to serialize concurrent add() operations across processes
risk_assessment: Low risk - uses standard POSIX file locking mechanism. Lock file (.todo.json.lock) is created alongside the database file.
limitations: fcntl.flock is Unix-only. Windows support would require a different mechanism (e.g., portalocker or msvcrt.locking).
